calculation_handling.description: Scope clause: the regulations of Section 150.7 apply to garden suites.
calculation_handling.gaps: Not a precedence rule, so ranks_layers is none. No zone named.

calculation_handling.description: For Chapter 150.7 (garden suites), "lawful" and "lawfully" also include anything existing or authorized on or before February 3, 2022.
calculation_handling.gaps: The date February 3, 2022 is a date and not keyed as a literal. The defined term is not a DSL variable. garden_suite evidence is the chapter scope phrase; the chapter applies to garden suites per 150.7.1(1).

150.7.1(1).explanation: Section 150.7 of the zoning by-law sets the rules for garden suites (a separate dwelling unit in a detached building in the back yard).

150.7.1(2).explanation: For the garden suite rules, anything that existed or was approved on or before February 3, 2022 counts as "lawful".
